scene_analysis.scene_overview: A view of a subway station with two ticket machines and a clock mounted on the wall. The station has a tiled floor and white walls. A man walks by carrying bags. There is a trashcan and a digital screen displaying information. The ticket machines have yellow fronts with black text and buttons. The clock shows 12:00.
scene_analysis.buildings: The building has a cream-colored facade with stone quoins at the corners. It is a tall structure with a flat roof.
scene_analysis.materials: The ticket machines have a yellow front with black text and buttons.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are no benches or other furniture visible.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are no plants or trees visible.
